thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency and 5xx spike on /v1/generate (region: us-west-2) detected at 2026-03-15T14:15:09Z. Deploy 2026-03-15T14:08:00Z referenced by deploy-id: d-4921. Errors: gateway timeout (504) and downstream 502. 

maria_oncall: acked. I'm on it. Can someone confirm which commit and which services were included in d-4921?

kevin_sre: that was a runtime + routing config change: kernel-selection tweak + kv-cache TTL bump to 60s (was 30s). commit: 9f3b2a5. rolling to all zones at 14:08.

nora_prod: seeing p95 jump from ~120ms to 550ms, p99 to 2.4s, and 504s at ~12% of requests for the last 6m. Customer-facing requests to chat endpoints are affected. (charts link) 

maria_oncall: ok prioritize rollback if rollback path exists. Can we revert the kv-cache TTL first? That was a low-risk config.

kevin_sre: quick check: config was loaded via feature flag (ff-kv-ttl). We can flip it back with `kubectl -n rollout set env config ff-kv-ttl=30 --selector=role=runtime` but recommend full rollback of d-4921 if timeouts persist.

nora_prod: agreement from product: customers seeing partial failures and timeouts -> impact: conversational sessions dropping, some retry loops causing downstream load. Tagged as P1.

maria_oncall: doing the flag flip now. @deploy-bot can you confirm and push the change?

deploy-bot: executed env update for selector role=runtime in namespace rollout. New rollout started at 2026-03-15T14:18:11Z. Monitoring progress. :gear:

kevin_sre: logs showing a lot of `kvcache: evict miss` and subsequent stall at the async fetch layer. Example stack snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:16:33Z runtime[pid=421]: kvcache: miss key=prefix-...
2026-03-15T14:16:33Z runtime[pid=421]: kv-fetch: waiting for remote (200ms)
2026-03-15T14:16:34Z runtime[pid=421]: request stalled waiting for kv response
```

nora_prod: Traffic is starting to recover in canary (us-west-2-a) but other zones still showing high p99. Rolling flag flip may not finish soon enough. Suggest rollback d-4921.

maria_oncall: agreed. @kevin_sre initiate rollback. Also open PD incident and notify support.

kevin_sre: rolling back now (rollback command: `deployctl rollback d-4921 --yes --force`). Executing.

deploy-bot: rollback triggered for d-4921 at 2026-03-15T14:21:07Z. Progress: 0/5 zones completed.

amelia_support: Support: sending templated customer notification: "We've detected an elevated error rate; our engineers are rolling back a recent deploy. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes." Sent to SRE-critical customers at 14:22.

maria_oncall: adding mitigations: temporarily widen routing to allow fallback to smaller model variant (model-v1-small) for time-sensitive endpoints. This reduces quality but lowers latency. `routing-policy set /v1/generate fallback=model-v1-small threshold=3s`

kevin_sre: fallback applied in us-west-2 at 14:23:55Z. Observed p99 drop from 2.4s -> 480ms in that zone. 5xx also decreasing. :thumbsup:

nora_prod: cross-region summary: us-west-2 -> significant recovery after rollback progress and fallback; eu-west-1 still showing ~6% 504s, investigating affinity configs and connection pool exhaustion.

maria_oncall: can someone check gateway connection pools? `nginx` upstreams show many TIME_WAIT. Might be keepalive/circuit thresholds.

kevin_sre: increasing keepalive timeout and bumping pool size small delta: `nginx_conf upstream_keepalive 64; upstream_max_fails 3;` applied via configmap and reload at 14:28:30Z.

deploy-bot: rollback status: 3/5 zones completed at 14:29:11Z. All completed by 14:31:09Z. Traffic reverted to previous runtime and routing kernel selection.

maria_oncall: checking ratios: overall 5xx dropped from 9% -> 0.7% across all zones after full rollback + keepalive + fallback. p99 back to ~180ms. This looks acceptable but continue to monitor for 30m.

nora_prod: customer impact summary for incident report: ~13 minutes of elevated errors (start 14:15 - mitigation effective ~14:28), affecting ~8% of production requests during peak; main root cause probable: aggressive kv-cache TTL bump combined with kernel-selection change causing cache churn and increased blocking on external kv store, cascading to gateway timeouts.

kevin_sre: follow-ups: add canary guardrails on ff-kv-ttl changes (gradual increase with churn metric), instrument kv-fetch async latency better, and add circuit breaker to prevent single-remote kv stalls from blocking request threads. I'll open tasks.

maria_oncall: handing off to night oncall @kevin_sre in 30m. Please take watch for 01:00-02:00 UTC window when customer traffic patterns change. We'll also schedule a postmortem with product and runtime team tomorrow.

amelia_support: sent second update to customers at 14:35: "Resolved: rollback completed and traffic normalized. We will follow up with a root cause summary."

incident-bot: Incident P1 created: INC-2026-0315-72. Pager duty notified and escalation matched.

maria_oncall: closing this thread but leaving monitoring on. If anything regresses reopen. Thanks team. :heart:

kevin_sre: noted. I'll file follow-up RFC and link to this thread.
